About the pitch

"As audit professionals, we bring the same rigor to your accounts that a formal audit would — so you always know exactly where you stand."

The service

Financial Health Review

A full review of your bookkeeping and financial statements to catch errors, close gaps, and correct your P&L and balance sheet.

  • A clean, corrected P&L and balance sheet Deliverable
  • A findings report, in plain language Deliverable
  • Financials ready for forecasting and budgeting Outcome
  • Books ready for tax preparation Outcome

How it works

A straightforward, three-step engagement.

1

Initial review

Send over your current books. We review your P&L, balance sheet, and reconciliations to understand where things stand.

2

Findings report

You get a clear, plain-language report on what's accurate, what's off, and what needs fixing — with priorities, not just a list.

3

Cleanup & handoff

We correct the books and hand back financials you can trust — ready for forecasting, budgeting, or tax preparation.
